about: Layer 3, the nightly live smoke (e2e/smoke.mjs): one posting per shape per night. `like`: rotating through the owner's own jobs whose address matches (read-only); `urls`: fixed public postings (from public job feeds; a gone one is reported, then replaced here). Chosen 10 Oct 2026 for different flows.
